summary: Tested new Up-Wash features: Quote request page, Scent Bomb quantity options, Route statistics summary, Calendar modal with full customer info, Monthly subscription auto-populate days, and Quote API endpoint. All features verified working as expected.
passed_tests: Homepage loads correctly with Bible verses
Services page displays all services including quote-based services
Scent Bomb service has quantity options (1-4 scent bombs with pricing $5/$10/$15/$20)
Home Power Washing click routes to /quote?service=home_powerwash (not /booking)
Quote Request Page (/quote) loads with form fields: name, phone, email, address, city, state, zip, description, preferred day (Thu/Fri/Either)
Quote services restricted to Thursday & Friday only (shown in form)
Admin login works with credentials Hughes0108 / Godfirst7!
Admin Calendar modal shows full booking details: customer name, address, phone, email, services, assigned documentor, price, status
Pending Routes page has search bar and Group by dropdown (Zip Code/City/State)
Route statistics summary displays when routes exist (Total Routes, Total Stops, Est. Documentor Pay, Zip Codes)
Booking page Monthly Subscription has 'Auto-select nearest days' button with data-testid
Quote Request API POST /api/quotes/request works correctly
Quote Request API validates required fields (returns 422 for missing data)
Admin GET /api/admin/quotes returns quote requests list
Services API returns quote-based services with pricing_type='quote'
